message.content: This editorial illustration for the magazine Tempo features a large, central star-shaped pit excavated into a sandy, beige ground. The pit's interior is composed of dark, jagged, concentric ridges that descend into a deep, shadowy blue-black center. The surrounding landscape is flat and light brown. Two small, stylized dump trucks are visible: one dark grey truck in the upper right and one bright green truck in the lower left. Both trucks carry mounds of dark material. At the top, the large word "TEMPO" is written in dark blue, serif lettering. Above it, text reads "REKENING TAMBUN PEJABAT PABEAN / PERTEMPURAN BARU GO-JEK VERSUS GRAB". Below "TEMPO" is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Large, bold white text on the left reads "PERANG BINTANG SENGKETA TAMBANG", with smaller white text below detailing coal land disputes. A red vertical border runs along the left edge. The bottom right contains the date "9-15 APRIL 2018", a price of "RP 45.000", a website URL, and a barcode.
